scientific_question: Under repaired measurement and outcome-only ecological credit, do exact point, signature-coarsened, or content-blind widened composite cells causally improve the frozen KRK host, and is widening selective relative to a population- and firing-rate-matched random merge?

hypotheses.H_point: Exact point cells produce a positive paired held-out effect relative to the frozen host.
hypotheses.H_signature: Removing exact percept-signature equality while retaining learned child conjunctions produces a positive paired held-out effect.
hypotheses.H_widened: Content-blind k-of-n widening produces a positive paired held-out effect through binary eligibility gating.
hypotheses.H_selectivity: Widening outperforms a population-, quorum-, and firing-rate-matched random merge.
hypotheses.H_L: At least one fixed additive dose has positive paired utility even if binary gating does not.

pools.generator: uniform random legal K+R versus K boards, White to move, filtered to nonterminal fence-established true-middle rows with no immediate mate and no forced mate in two
pools.canonical_group: minimum piece-square tuple over the eight D4 board symmetries; side to move and piece identities retained
disjointness: no exact FEN overlap among splits
no canonical D4 orbit overlap among splits
no exact or orbit overlap with rows 600-727
no exact or orbit overlap with the five named prior row/start artifacts
pools.manifest_hash: sha256 of canonical compact JSON containing split, ordered row records, generator contract, and preregistration hash
pools.final_seal: final manifest is generated and hashed with the other splits, then its rows are not loaded by selection code

host_and_outcome.white_host: standing Phase-3 migrated Stage-B flat graph host reconstructed from sealed stage_d_B weights and the native foundation graph
host_and_outcome.black_policy: lexicographically maximize rook capture, distance from the white king, centrality, successor legal mobility, then UCI
prohibited_credit_or_selection_sources: Mate-in-1, Mate-in-2, enter_mate2, or authored child-skill confirmations
tablebase, DTM, Stockfish, exact first-move validators

candidate_construction.training_episode: one frozen-host game per TRAIN row and experiment seed; every selected White action inherits only that game's terminal credit
candidate_construction.nomination_score: mean terminal credit minus seed-global mean terminal credit
candidate_construction.nomination_order: descending positive nomination score, descending support, stable sha256 cell ID
candidate_construction.no_positive_nominee_rule: materialize no learned cells for that topology; do not rescue with shaped credit

exact_point.children: two learner-visible action keys observed together in nominated TRAIN actions

signature_coarsened.children: same two-key outcome-nominated units, aggregated without signature

widened.construction: stable greedy merge of nominated point prototypes sharing at least one child; no outcome is consulted after prototype nomination

matched_random.population: one random cell per widened cell
matched_random.children: seeded draws without replacement from learner-visible keys in the same TRAIN marginal-frequency deciles
matched_random.matching: select the closest firing-rate draw from 64 draws on VALIDATION without consulting outcomes

constructed_ceiling.purpose: prove FormalReCon predicate evaluation, live binary gate application, and a deterministic move flip on a sealed constructed row

routing.counterfactual_isolation: every arm and dose restores one immutable post-training snapshot; stable IDs are reacquired from live runtime state after every restore

configuration_selection.per_topology_candidates: G on and L at x1/x3/x9/x27
lexicographic_rule: larger aggregate favorable-minus-unfavorable discordants versus baseline
G before L on an exact tie
lower L dose on an exact tie

detectability.adequate_topology: at least one cell reaches minimum support in at least three of five seeds

statistics.paired_unit: same source row and experiment seed
statistics.sign_test: exact one-sided binomial test conditional on discordants
statistics.multiplicity: Holm correction across the five primary comparisons independently on VALIDATION and, if unlocked, FINAL-TEST

requirements: at least one non-random topology is adequately detectable
for at least one non-random selected configuration favorable > unfavorable
validation_freeze_gate.failure_action: do not load or evaluate FINAL-TEST

requirements: measurement and validation freeze gates passed

stop_rules: stop before experimentation if exact stratified orbit-disjoint pools cannot be generated
stop before causal evaluation if no-op parity fails
stop interpretation if the constructed ceiling fails
do not touch FINAL-TEST if the validation freeze gate fails
do not add rescue arms or operators after results
do not run another v1 KRK closure
do not start KPK or hierarchy/parent-credit/virtual-frame refactors in this run

interpretations.widened_G_all_gates: Under outcome-only ecological credit and repaired measurement, content-blind widening produced a selective causal benefit through binary gating in the current frozen KRK host.
interpretations.adequate_all_flat: The current v1 KRK ecology/representation/routing intervention produced no detectable causal benefit at the preregistered scale.
interpretations.only_L: Discovered/widened structure has additive causal utility under the tested host, but conditional non-linear routing was not established.
interpretations.random_matches_widening: The benefit is not selective to the widening operator or discovered content.
interpretations.measurement_failure: The closure is invalid as a scientific experiment.
interpretations.outcome_starvation_or_under_detectabilit: Outcome-only credit did not produce an adequately detectable ecology at the preregistered scale; no positive or causal-null classification is made, and the v1 KRK ecological line nevertheless closes.

final_test_touch_contract.touch_definition: deserializing FINAL-TEST row records into the evaluator
